[ASSISTANT] Based on the CLI discovery, here is a summary of the **extraction models available to your Maestro flow** via UiPath IXP:

---

## Available Extraction Models

The `uip ixp projects configure-model` command accepts a `--model` flag validated server-side. The supported extraction models are:

| Model Identifier | Provider | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `gemini_2_5_flash` | Google Gemini | Fast, cost-efficient model |
| `gemini_2_5_pro` | Google Gemini | Higher capability model |
| `gpt_4o_2024_05_13` | OpenAI GPT-4o | OpenAI's GPT-4o (May 2024 version) |

---

## Preprocessing Options

Alongside the model, you can also configure **intelligent pre-processing** via `--preprocessing`:

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `none` | No pre-processing |
| `table_mini` | Light table detection |
| `table` | Full table pre-processing |

---

## Context

Your tenant currently has one IXP project: **"Vendor Invoices"** (`vendor_invoices-3e19dd82-ixp`). To configure the extraction model for it, you would run:

```bash
uip ixp projects configure-model vendor_invoices-3e19dd82-ixp \
  --model gemini_2_5_pro \
  --preprocessing table \
  --output json
```

> **Note:** Model identifiers are validated server-side, so the three models listed above (`gemini_2_5_flash`, `gemini_2_5_pro`, `gpt_4o_2024_05_13`) are the documented supported options. If additional models have been provisioned on your tenant, the server will accept them — but these are the known valid values from the CLI.

content_blocks.text:
Based on the CLI discovery, here is a summary of the **extraction models available to your Maestro flow** via UiPath IXP:

---

## Available Extraction Models

The `uip ixp projects configure-model` command accepts a `--model` flag validated server-side. The supported extraction models are:

| Model Identifier | Provider | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `gemini_2_5_flash` | Google Gemini | Fast, cost-efficient model |
| `gemini_2_5_pro` | Google Gemini | Higher capability model |
| `gpt_4o_2024_05_13` | OpenAI GPT-4o | OpenAI's GPT-4o (May 2024 version) |

---

## Preprocessing Options

Alongside the model, you can also configure **intelligent pre-processing** via `--preprocessing`:

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `none` | No pre-processing |
| `table_mini` | Light table detection |
| `table` | Full table pre-processing |

---

## Context

Your tenant currently has one IXP project: **"Vendor Invoices"** (`vendor_invoices-3e19dd82-ixp`). To configure the extraction model for it, you would run:

```bash
uip ixp projects configure-model vendor_invoices-3e19dd82-ixp \
  --model gemini_2_5_pro \
  --preprocessing table \
  --output json
```

> **Note:** Model identifiers are validated server-side, so the three models listed above (`gemini_2_5_flash`, `gemini_2_5_pro`, `gpt_4o_2024_05_13`) are the documented supported options. If additional models have been provisioned on your tenant, the server will accept them — but these are the known valid values from the CLI.

    command: '! find . -name "*.flow" -type f | grep -q .'
